Name: Functional lipstick machine
Author: AbrahMods
Description:
[b][color=#ff00ff][i]Abrah’s Lipstick Machine:[/i][/color][/b]
A cosmetic crafting mod that adds a Lipstick Machine that can turn fruits and desserts into lipstick and lipgloss! Click on the player to wear the product.

[color=#ff00ff] How to Get the Machine[/color]
[*]It's in the crafting recipes section and can be crafted with 50 wood, 20 stone and 1 amethyst.
